obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: be completed within two hours of when the impactor to be used is removed from the controlled storage area
obligations.ears: Each test shall be completed within two hours of when the impactor to be used is removed from the controlled storage area.

obligations.subject: e40
obligations.response: be in the bumper test area
obligations.ears: The selected target points shall be in the bumper test area.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: be in the horizontal plane and parallel to the longitudinal vertical plane of the vehicle
obligations.ears: The direction of the impact velocity vector shall be in the horizontal plane and parallel to the longitudinal vertical plane of the vehicle.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: be ± 2° at the time of first contact
obligations.ears: At the time of first contact, the tolerance for the direction of the velocity vector in the horizontal plane and in the longitudinal plane shall be ± 2°.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: be perpendicular to the horizontal plane, with a roll and pitch angle tolerance of ± 2° in the lateral and longitudinal plane
obligations.ears: The axis of the impactor shall be perpendicular to the horizontal plane, with a roll and pitch angle tolerance of ± 2° in the lateral and longitudinal plane.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: be 75 mm above the ground reference plane at the time of the first contact with the bumper (see Figure 21), with a tolerance of ± 10 mm
obligations.ears: At the time of the first contact with the bumper, the bottom of the impactor (without parts needed for the purposes of launching and/or protection) shall be 75 mm above the ground reference plane (see Figure 21), with a tolerance of ± 10 mm.

obligations.subject: n2
obligations.response: an allowance shall be made for the influence of gravity during the period of free flight of the impactor
obligations.ears: When setting the height of the propulsion system, an allowance shall be made for the influence of gravity during the period of free flight of the impactor.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: be in 'free flight' at the moment of impact
obligations.ears: The lower legform impactor for the bumper tests shall be in 'free flight' at the moment of impact.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: be released to free flight at such a distance from the vehicle that the test results are not influenced by contact of the impactor with the propulsion system during the rebound of the impactor
obligations.ears: The impactor shall be released to free flight at such a distance from the vehicle that the test results are not influenced by contact of the impactor with the propulsion system during the rebound of the impactor.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: may be propelled by any means that can be shown to meet the requirements of the test
obligations.ears: The impactor may be propelled by any means that can be shown to meet the requirements of the test.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: have the intended orientation about its vertical axis, for the correct operation of its knee joint, with a yaw angle tolerance of ± 5° (see Figure 20)
obligations.ears: At the time of first contact, the impactor shall have the intended orientation about its vertical axis, for the correct operation of its knee joint, with a yaw angle tolerance of ± 5° (see Figure 20).
